case_results.observation: The name-and-description routing projection is byte-identical to the three-round v1.0.1 routing acceptance.
The unchanged routing projection remains covered by the three-round corporate-gift acceptance.
The unchanged routing projection remains covered by the three-round souvenir acceptance.

The unchanged routing projection remains covered by the three-round jewelry anti-trigger acceptance.

The unchanged routing projection remains covered by the watch anti-trigger acceptance.
The final-package live GLM run selected and froze the human-relations root without a Skill override, governance metadata, or free-text branch rejection.
A final-package live GLM run preserved the exact local business and local map paths without a denylist, although it still selected the broader preferred root.
The final-package held-out selected the human-relations root on one documented full-chain recovery run after the initial final-map payload remained empty through built-in repair.

limitations: Acceptance is bounded to businesses where gifting is the stated commercial object.
It does not establish correctness for every gift subcategory, every language variant, or repeated-run stability.
The explicit-local run preserved local paths but did not promote them to the root, so the soft preference may still be too strong.
One held-out required a manual full-chain recovery run after structured-output repair was exhausted.
The full incubation chain still carries documented latency and token-cost debt.
